title: Accept real contact inquiries only after approved readiness
description:
As an operator, I want safe contact intake beyond the synthetic evaluation.

Feature: Accept real contact inquiries only after approved readiness
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given the existing synthetic-only intake and its reviewed deployment proposal
    When real-contact capture is considered
    Then operating ownership privacy retention abuse controls writer reconciliation and real-cloud failure acceptance are approved before enabling it

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Basic contact/demo inquiry follows the core account acceptance path and must preserve the synthetic evaluation readiness gates already recorded. Real-contact activation remains blocked until operating owner, privacy/retention, abuse controls, writer reconciliation and real-cloud failure acceptance have concrete approval.

Feature: Basic inquiry capture
  Scenario: Return a receipt for an allowed inquiry
    Given approved intake scope and enabled runtime
    When a contact/demo inquiry is saved and retried after an uncertain response
    Then one durable inquiry is available for authorized follow-up with source and receipt history
    And no membership appointment charge or credit is created

PR13 addresses wording only; its passing application check is not evidence of production intake activation. Billing design must not block the basic account/login path.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.
